title: 第6章 纠缠不休第7章 赵史的复仇
content_zh:
：他妈的怎么又是303，名字房间号都一样，这难道是巧合？
“我领您上去？”
“不用，我自己来就行。”
我拒绝了那男人之后，他就佝偻着腰，又打着灯笼出去了，走到门口的时候，又回过头对我诡异的笑了笑。
我被他这笑容搞的浑身不自在，慌慌张张的跑上了三楼，这303还是个尾号房，妈的真他妈晦气。
人都说尾号房常年见不到阳光容易招脏东西，三叔说我是纯阴命格的人最易招鬼物，这怎么就这么点背被我摊上了。
我打开房门一股腐烂发霉的味道扑面而来，我被呛的打了几个喷嚏，在看屋里的环境，就一张破床，墙上的墙皮泛黄剥落了，而且整间屋子都阴嗖嗖的，我感到后背传来一股凉意，不禁使我打了个冷战。
我怀疑这房间里是不是有什么脏东西，就双手合十朝房间的四个角双手合十的拜了拜：“无意打扰，借住一宿，有怪莫怪。”
拜完之后，心情稍微平复了一下，我就上床睡觉了，睡到后半夜的时候，我突然感觉到脸凉凉的，像是有人在对我吹气。
累了一天我也不想理会，就翻个身继续睡了，可是这时候耳边突然传来了凄厉的笑声，我瞬间惊醒，这声音怎么那么像刘倩倩？
我听见这个诡异的笑声，吓得急忙从床上翻了起来，回头正好碰到刘倩倩的面孔，虽然看着很精致，但我却被吓得大叫了一声，急忙往后退去，直到顶到后面的墙壁，我退无可退惊慌失措的大叫道：
“刘倩倩我可没有杀了你，俗话说冤有头债有主，一直缠着我干嘛。”
“我说过！
三日后和我回村成婚，不然你全家都得和你一起陪葬！”
刘倩倩说完便张出血盆大口，朝我咬了过来，而她嘴上的恶臭瞬间扑鼻而来！
刘倩倩嘴上的恶臭，带着一股尸体腐烂很久破败的味道！
我被这股恶臭反胃到，差点把中午吃的饭全部呕吐了出来！
看着刘倩倩带着恶臭的大嘴向我咬了过来，我吓得急忙掏出胸前的玉佩，向刘芊芊拍了过去！
“啊！”
玉佩传来耀眼的白色光芒，刘倩倩的身体刚碰到玉佩的光芒，瞬间倒飞了出去，口中不断吐出些许黑气！

“又是这块破玉佩！”
刘倩倩在原地失控咆哮着怒吼！
而刘倩倩的身体也随着玉佩的光照，开始慢慢的腐败开来，皮肤如同干枯的气球慢慢枯萎，渐渐的变成干尸的形状，身上的黑气也越来越浓郁，缠绕在刘倩倩的身上！
看着面前如此渗人的场景，我吓得拔腿就跑，立马冲向门边，一把直接把门踹开，头也不回的，急忙向楼梯间跑去！
刚跑到楼梯间，我便听见身后传来刘倩倩的怒吼！
犹如滔天的杀意一般从房间冲了出来，房门直接被撞得粉碎！
奇怪的是，整个客栈仿佛没有人注意到，这边传来如此之大的躁动，甚至说整个客栈除了我还有老板娘和刚刚那个店小二以外，仿佛我也没再见过任何活人。
不过还来不及过多思考这些，我看着身后的刘倩倩飞速的向我追了过来，脸皮干枯如同死皮一般！
双眼的眼珠已完全凹了进去，只有黑漆漆的瞳孔，仿佛要把人吞没进去！
我急忙向一楼跑去，当时我的脑海只有一个想法，跑！
跑的越远越好！
content_en:
: Why the hell is it 303 again, with the same name and room number? Is this a coincidence?
"Shall I take you up?"
"No, I can do it myself."
After I rejected the man, he stooped and went out with a lantern. When he walked to the door, he turned back and smiled weirdly at me.
His smile made me feel uncomfortable all over, and I ran up to the third floor in a panic. Room 303 was the last room, so it was really unlucky.
People say that the room with the last number, which does not see sunlight all the year round, is prone to attract evil things. My third uncle said that I am a pure Yin person who is most likely to attract ghosts. Why did I end up with such a small amount of trouble?
I opened the door and a rotten and moldy smell hit my face. I was choked and sneezed a few times. I looked at the environment in the room. There was only a broken bed, the walls were yellow and peeling, and the whole room was dark. I felt a chill on my back, which made me shiver.
I suspected if there was something dirty in the room, so I clasped my hands and bowed to the four corners of the room: "I don't want to disturb you. I'm staying here for the night. Don't blame me if you find anything strange."
After praying, my mood calmed down a little, and I went to bed. When I slept until midnight, I suddenly felt a cold face, as if someone was blowing on me.
After a tired day, I didn't want to pay attention to it, so I turned over and went back to sleep. But then a shrill laughter suddenly came from my ears, and I woke up instantly. Why did this voice sound so like Liu Qianqian?
I heard this weird laughter and was so frightened that I hurriedly rolled up from the bed. When I turned around, I happened to bump into Liu Qianqian's face. Although it looked very delicate, I was so frightened that I screamed and backed away hurriedly until I hit the wall behind. I couldn't retreat and yelled in panic:
"Liu Qianqian, I didn't kill you. As the saying goes, every injustice has its owner, so why are you pestering me?"
"I said it!
Come back to the village with me and get married in three days, otherwise your whole family will be buried with you! "
After Liu Qianqian finished speaking, she opened her big mouth and bit me, and the stench from her mouth hit my nostrils instantly!
The stench on Liu Qianqian's mouth smelled like a corpse that had been rotting for a long time!
I was so nauseated by the stench that I almost vomited out all my lunch!
Seeing Liu Qianqian bite me with her foul-smelling mouth, I was so frightened that I quickly took out the jade pendant on my chest and patted Liu Qianqian!
"Ah!"
A dazzling white light came from the jade pendant. As soon as Liu Qianqian's body touched the light of the jade pendant, she flew backwards and spit out some black energy from her mouth!
"It's this broken jade pendant again!"
Liu Qianqian lost control on the spot and roared angrily!
And Liu Qianqian's body began to slowly decay with the light of the jade pendant. Her skin slowly withered like a dry balloon, gradually turning into the shape of a mummy. The black energy on her body became more and more intense, wrapping around Liu Qianqian's body!
Seeing such an intrusive scene in front of me, I was so frightened that I ran away. I immediately rushed to the door, kicked it open, and ran towards the stairwell without looking back!
As soon as I ran to the stairwell, I heard Liu Qianqian's roar from behind me!
Like a monstrous murderous intent, he rushed out of the room, and the door was smashed into pieces!
The strange thing is that no one in the entire inn seems to have noticed that there is such a big commotion here. It is even said that except for me, the proprietress and the waiter from just now, it seems that I have never seen any living person in the entire inn.
But before I had time to think too much about this, I saw Liu Qianqian chasing me quickly behind me, her face as dry as dead skin!
The eyeballs of both eyes have been completely sunken, with only dark pupils, as if they are about to swallow the person up!
I hurriedly ran to the first floor. At that time, I had only one thought in my mind, run!
The further you run, the better!
